title_en: Regulations on the Establishment and Staffing of Administrative Organs of the State Council

articles.content_en: These Regulations are formulated in accordance with the Constitution and the Organic Law of the State Council for the purpose of regulating the establishment of the administrative organs of the State Council, strengthening staffing management, and improving administrative efficiency.

The establishment of administrative organs of the State Council and the management of their staffing shall meet the needs of the country's political, economic and social development and follow the principles of simplification, unification and efficiency.

The State Council shall, in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution and the Organic Law of the State Council, exercise the powers of establishing administrative organs and managing their staffing.
Under the leadership of the State Council, the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management shall be responsible for the specific work concerning the establishment of administrative organs of the State Council and the management of their staffing.

The establishment of administrative organs of the State Council shall be based on the scientific allocation of functions, so as to achieve clear functions, reasonable division of labor, and streamlined organs, thus facilitating the improvement of administrative effectiveness.
The State Council shall, in accordance with the needs of national economic and social development and the requirements of the socialist market economy system, make timely adjustments to its administrative organs; however, within the term of one government, the constituent departments of the State Council shall remain relatively stable.

The establishment, dissolution or merger of an administrative organ of the State Council shall be subject to evaluation and demonstration organized in advance by the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management in conjunction with the relevant departments and experts.

The administrative organs of the State Council shall, according to their functions, be divided into the General Office of the State Council, the constituent departments of the State Council, the organs directly under the State Council, the offices of the State Council, the state administrative organs administered by the constituent departments of the State Council, and the deliberation and coordination organs of the State Council.
The General Office of the State Council shall assist the leaders of the State Council in handling the routine work of the State Council.
The constituent departments of the State Council shall respectively perform the basic administrative management functions of the State Council according to law. The constituent departments of the State Council include the various ministries and commissions, the People's Bank of China and the National Audit Office.
The organs directly under the State Council shall be in charge of specific specialized businesses of the State Council and have independent administrative management functions.
The offices of the State Council shall assist the Premier of the State Council in handling specialized matters and do not have independent administrative management functions.
The state administrative organs administered by the constituent departments of the State Council shall be managed by the constituent departments of the State Council, be in charge of specific businesses, and exercise administrative management functions.
The deliberation and coordination organs of the State Council shall undertake the tasks of organizing and coordinating important cross-administrative-organ work of the State Council. Matters decided by the deliberation and coordination organs of the State Council shall, with the consent of the State Council, be handled by the relevant administrative organs according to their respective functions. In special or emergency circumstances, with the consent of the State Council, the deliberation and coordination organs of the State Council may formulate temporary administrative management measures.

In accordance with the provisions of the Organic Law of the State Council, the State Council shall establish the General Office.
The establishment, dissolution or merger of a constituent department of the State Council shall be proposed by the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management, submitted to the State Council executive meeting for discussion and approval, and then submitted by the Premier of the State Council to the National People's Congress for decision; during the recess of the National People's Congress, it shall be submitted to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for decision.

The establishment, dissolution or merger of the organs directly under the State Council, the offices of the State Council and the state administrative organs administered by the constituent departments of the State Council shall be proposed by the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management and submitted to the State Council for decision.

The establishment of a deliberation and coordination organ of the State Council shall be strictly controlled; if the functions can be undertaken by an existing organ or if the problems can be solved through coordination by an existing organ, no separate deliberation and coordination organ shall be established.
For the establishment of a deliberation and coordination organ of the State Council, the specific working department that undertakes the office functions shall be clearly defined; for a deliberation and coordination organ established to handle a specific task within a certain period, the conditions for its dissolution or the time limit for its dissolution shall also be clearly defined.

The establishment, dissolution or merger of a deliberation and coordination organ of the State Council shall be proposed by the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management and submitted to the State Council for decision.

After an administrative organ of the State Council is established, if its functions need to be adjusted, the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management shall propose a plan and submit it to the State Council for decision.

The General Office of the State Council, the constituent departments of the State Council, the organs directly under the State Council, and the offices of the State Council shall, on the basis of functional decomposition, establish internal bodies at the department level and the division level; the state administrative organs administered by the constituent departments of the State Council may, according to work needs, establish internal bodies at both the department and division levels, or may establish only internal bodies at the division level.

The addition, dissolution or merger of an internal body at the department level of an administrative organ of the State Council shall be subject to review of the plan by the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management and shall be submitted to the State Council for approval.
The establishment, dissolution or merger of an internal body at the division level of an administrative organ of the State Council shall be decided by the administrative organ of the State Council in accordance with the relevant state provisions, and shall be reported to the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management for record on an annual basis.

The names of the administrative organs of the State Council and their internal bodies at the department level shall be standardized and clear, and shall be commensurate with the type and functions of such organs or bodies.
The administrative organs of the State Council and their internal bodies at the department level may not change their names without authorization.

The staffing of an administrative organ of the State Council shall be determined on the basis of function allocation and position classification, in accordance with the principle of simplification.
The staffing referred to in the preceding paragraph includes the fixed number of personnel and the number of leading positions.

The staffing of an administrative organ of the State Council shall be determined at the time of its establishment.
A plan for the staffing of an administrative organ of the State Council shall include the following matters:
(1) the fixed number of personnel of the organ and the proportion of personnel structure;
(2) the number of leading positions of the organ and the number of leading positions of internal bodies at the department level.

An increase or decrease in the staffing of an administrative organ of the State Council shall be subject to review of the plan by the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management and shall be submitted to the State Council for approval.

Deliberation and coordination organs of the State Council shall not have their staffing determined separately; the staffing needed shall be provided by the administrative organ of the State Council that undertakes the specific work.

The number of leading positions in the General Office of the State Council, the constituent departments of the State Council, the organs directly under the State Council, and the offices of the State Council shall be determined in accordance with the provisions of the Organic Law of the State Council. The number of leading positions in the state administrative organs administered by the constituent departments of the State Council shall be determined by reference to the provisions of the Organic Law of the State Council on the number of leading positions in the organs directly under the State Council.
The number of leading positions in the internal bodies at the department level of the General Office of the State Council, the constituent departments of the State Council, the organs directly under the State Council, and the offices of the State Council shall be one principal and two deputies; the number of leading positions in the internal bodies at the department level of the state administrative organs administered by the constituent departments of the State Council shall, according to work needs, be one principal and two deputies or one principal and one deputy.
The number of leading positions in the internal bodies at the division level of the administrative organs of the State Council shall be determined in accordance with the relevant state provisions.

The State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management shall supervise and inspect the establishment of administrative organs of the State Council and the implementation of staffing.
The administrative organs of the State Council shall provide each year a report on the status of their establishment and staffing management to the State Council's organ for administrative organization and staffing management.

Measures for the management of the establishment and staffing of administrative organs of local people's governments at various levels shall be formulated separately.
Administrative organs of the State Council may not interfere in the management of the establishment and staffing of administrative organs of local people's governments at various levels, and may not require local people's governments at various levels to establish administrative organs corresponding to their businesses.
These Regulations shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
